profiles.name: MiniMax H3 audio + video
profiles.description: Offline MiniMax-H3 generation through audio.cpp release-0.6. The Yeti profile is tuned for a 12 GB RTX 4070: Q4_K, memory saver, layerwise weights, short 480p video, and audio-first defaults.
requirements: audio.cpp release-0.6 audiocpp_cli built with CUDA
NVIDIA driver/toolkit compatible with the audio.cpp CUDA build
notes: The normal Q4_K DiT is the default; the optional INT8 ConvRot package is not selected because audio.cpp reports a higher peak-memory path.
Video defaults to 480p and 121 frames (about five seconds at 24 fps). Use --video to request synchronized video output.
When ffmpeg, jq, and xxd are available, --video also muxes the RGB24 payload with the generated WAV into a playable MP4; the raw JSON artifact is retained.
H3 is experimental and can be slow on 12 GB. Keep other GPU-heavy models unloaded while generating.

profiles.name: LTX-2.5 synchronized video
profiles.variant: 22B distilled, FP8-cast at load, CPU offload
profiles.description: Text-to-video/audio generation through the official LTX-2.5 DistilledPipeline. The official BF16 transformer is quantized to FP8 while loading and offloaded to CPU; an explicit transformer-path override is available for future compatible pre-quantized releases.
requirements: Lightricks/LTX-2 checkout with uv sync --extra natten
Hugging Face access to the gated LTX-2.5 files
about 66 GiB of model storage plus CPU RAM and swap
notes: The official LTX-2.5 repository currently publishes BF16 split components; no official pre-quantized Ada transformer is listed. The selected fp8-cast policy still stores the eligible transformer linears in FP8 during inference.
The newly reported 2.5 NVFP4 transformer is a Blackwell-oriented path and is about 18.7 GB before runtime overhead, so it is not selected for this 12 GB Ada host.
The convolutional video VAE is selected to avoid requiring the diffusion VAE attention extra during decode.
Use --transformer PATH with the matching --quantization policy only after a pre-quantized artifact has been verified against the official ltx-pipelines loader.
The distilled pipeline accepts still-image conditioning through --image PATH FRAME STRENGTH. Use a dedicated LTX pipeline for audio-to-video or video-to-video inputs.

profiles.name: HeartMuLa local music generation
profiles.description: Offline prompt-, tag-, and lyrics-conditioned song generation through audio.cpp using its published HeartMuLa Q8_0 GGUF package.
requirements: audio.cpp release-0.6 audiocpp_cli built with HeartMuLa and CUDA
HeartMuLa Q8_0 GGUF package in L3MS_MEDIA_ROOT
NVIDIA driver/toolkit compatible with the audio.cpp CUDA build
notes: The Q8_0 package is audio.cpp's recommended HeartMuLa download and contains the MuLa generator and HeartCodec assets in one GGUF.
Use --instrumental for a no-vocals tag preset or --lyrics/--lyrics-file for a supplied lyric sheet.
Memory saver is enabled for the 12 GB Yeti profile; keep llama-swap GPU models unloaded during generation.
